module TopModule (
    input  a,
    input  b,
    input  c,
    input  d,
    output q
);

    // q is driven inside a continuous assignment block, so declare as logic
    assign q = (a & b & c & d) |
               (a & b &  ~c &  d) |
               (a & b &  ~c & ~d) |
               (~a &  b &  c & ~d) |
               (~a &  b &  c &  d) |
               (~a &  b & ~c &  d) |
               (~a & ~b &  c &  d) |
               (~a & ~b &  c & ~d) |
               (~a & ~b & ~c &  d);

endmodule
